intro.title: Visit the atelier, or leave us a note.
intro.subtitle: Choosing a design, booking a fitting or commissioning a made-to-measure piece for an important occasion — tell us about it and a tailor will answer you directly.

phone.label: Hotline
phone.note: Call during opening hours to reach a consultant.

zalo.label: Zalo
zalo.note: Send reference photos and measurements — easiest from afar.

message.title: Tell us about your occasion
message.description: No need to know your measurements or a design name. A few lines about the occasion, timing and what you have in mind are enough to start.

read.title: A tailor reads your note
read.description: During opening hours, expect a first reply within about 15–30 minutes.

call.title: We call to understand your needs
call.description: We talk through your figure, fabrics, budget and the date you need it.

meet.title: Book a fitting or send measurements
meet.description: Visit the showroom to be measured, or measure at home with our guide.

form.name: Full name
form.messagePlaceholder: e.g. I need a red wedding ao dai for December…
form.privacy: Your details are only used to get back to you and are never shared with third parties.
form.success: Thank you! Your note has been sent — we will be in touch shortly.
form.sendError: Could not send your note. Please try again or call our hotline.

visit.title: Come for a fitting and a cup of tea
visit.address: AODAI Showroom, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City
visit.note: Book ahead to have a dedicated tailor measure and fit you without waiting.

reply.question: How soon will I hear back?
reply.answer: Usually within 15–30 minutes during opening hours. Notes sent after hours are answered the next morning.

appointment.question: Do I need to book a fitting in advance?
appointment.answer: It is not required, but booking ahead gets you a dedicated tailor and the designs you like ready to try.

custom.question: I live far away — can I still order made to measure?
custom.answer: Yes. Send your measurements via Zalo or email following our guide, and we tailor and deliver to your door.

exchange.question: Can I exchange the size after delivery?
exchange.answer: Ready-to-wear pieces can be exchanged for another size under our policy if tags are intact and unworn.
